content: TanStack Router (v1) offers fully-typed route params/search-params/loaders with zero codegen and is explicitly recommended for client-heavy dashboards/admin panels/internal tools. React Router v7 is the safer/larger-ecosystem default but its strongest type-safety features require 'framework mode' (SSR), which is not needed here; used as a pure SPA library it loses much of its v7 advantage over v6.
